items.summary: Consumer products giant Clorox (NYSE:CLX) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 2% year on year to $1.95 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.66 per share was 0.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
